WORDS: James Montgomery, pub.1816; v. 5 by Unknown, pub.1825. MUSIC: “Regent Square”; Henry T. Smart, pub.1867. Public Domain.

There was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying, Glory to God in the highest. Lk. 2:13-14 The desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts. Hag. 2:7
